title: Halloween Events
description: Paranormal phenomena and sinister encounters plaguing Los Santos and Blaine County during the Halloween season.

subcategories.title: Slashers
subcategories.description: Psychopaths and serial killers lurking in the dark during the darkest nights of San Andreas.

items.title: The Slasher Clown
items.description: A maniac with sinister face paint and a twisted smile armed with a dagger. Stalks players roaming dark alleys alone on foot between 21:00 and 05:00.
details: Requires being in free roam session for at least 16 minutes.
Only spawns if the player is not inside weaponized or flying vehicles.
An ominous sound cue plays when the stalker draws near.

items.title: The Phantom Car
items.description: A classic black muscle car engulfed in phantom flames steered by an ethereal demonic figure. Relentlessly chases players down to run them over.
details: Vehicle resists common collision damage until the driver is taken down.
The car's fire does not extinguish under rain.
Destruction awards instant cash bonus.

items.title: The Paleto Butcher
items.description: A hulking murderer wearing a bloodstained apron and surgical mask brandishing a rusty chainsaw, lurking in the dense northern woods.
details: Possesses significantly higher health pool than regular NPCs.
Immune to knockdown from standard bullet impacts.
Drops heavy ammunition and full first-aid kit upon defeat.

subcategories.title: Ghosts
subcategories.description: Paranormal sightings and ethereal manifestations documented by the San Andreas Paranormal Society.

items.title: Ghost of Mount Gordo
items.description: The tragic spirit of Celene Mountain, appearing strictly for sixty real-time seconds between 23:00 and 00:00 on the cliff overlooking El Gordo Lighthouse.
details: Fades away immediately if the player gets closer than 5 meters.
The word 'JOCK' is inscribed in blood on the rock surface.
Must photograph the apparition with Snapmatic to log evidence.

items.title: Apparition of Leonora Johnson
items.description: The tragic 1970s Vinewood starlet manifests levitating in gloom near the Pacific Bluffs mausoleum, whispering lamentations of the unsolved crime.
details: Appears floating over an unmarked tombstone.
Snapmatic camera required to capture the spectral evidence.
Photographing all 10 ghosts unlocks the Ghosts Exposed livery for the Albany Brigham.

title: Holiday Events
description: Winter festive celebrations featuring snowfall across San Andreas, opportunistic festive muggers, and collectible snowmen.

subcategories.title: The Gooch
subcategories.description: A sinister green furry creature wearing Santa attire that ambushes unsuspecting players in free roam.

items.title: The Gooch Ambush
items.description: Emerges from a green cloud of smoke with a cackling laugh, knocks the player down, robs cash and snacks, and runs away quickly.
items.reward: The Gooch Mask, reclaimed stolen items + $25,000
details: Requires at least 2 players in the session and carrying pocket cash.
Player must chase and eliminate him before he escapes to reclaim loot.
First defeat unlocks the full Gooch Festive Outfit.

subcategories.title: Snowmen
subcategories.description: 25 festive snowmen placed throughout the snowy state of San Andreas waiting to be destroyed.

items.title: Snowmen Destruction
items.description: Handcrafted frozen statues found in parks, rooftops, backyards and porches across San Andreas. Can be destroyed by ramming, shooting, or explosives.
items.reward: The Snowman Outfit + $125,000 upon destroying all 25
details: Each destroyed snowman rewards $5,000 and 1,000 RP.
Completing all 25 awards a bonus lump sum of $125,000.
Emits a distinct jingle bell audio cue when standing near.
